The scope is the licence, the root README and the whole of above324_refined/. LICENSE is byte-identical to the copy the de-winter-upper-bounds-227-229-260-2026-10-17 packet retains, and the 16 earlier certificates and verify_cert.py to the copies the de-winter-issue942-2026-11-10 packet retains from a9486ed (verify_cert.py through that packet's pin against the de-winter-issue941-2026-11-10 copy), and each is pinned against its copy. above324_refined/SHA256SUMS states the SHA-256 of all 22 certificates and verify_cert.py, and all 23 match. claims: a0c4fc8 adds to above324_refined/ six exact rational certificates in the folder's format, at 597, 754, 864, 865, 869 and 991. #942's addendum comment and above324_refined/README.md print each side rounded up at 10 places: 597 24.8969258585, 754 27.9075316299, 864 29.8530288378, 865 29.8693054513, 869 29.9122235088, 991 31.9019684133, each below the register value and the best public competition value the author could find, which the addendum prints beside them. The addendum says the certificates, checker, margin (about 5e-9 above the numerical optimum), lineage and AI assistance are as #942 states.

The folder README at a0c4fc8 calls the 22 packings 'Refined public packings above n = 324', says the arrangements of the squares are unchanged from the starting packings, and that the descent test, local optimization, rational certificates and checking were produced with Claude (Anthropic) under Joost de Winter's direction. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
